findings.source_quote: It is said that it was his encounter with God at the bedside of that dying man that prompted Lyte’s noble hymn, “Jesus, I My Cross Have Taken.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted hymn title into Urdu rather than leaving it in English. Preserve the quotation marks and HTML structure. findings.source_quote: But, as Thou dwell’st with Thy disciples, Lord, Familiar, condescending, patient, free,
findings.suggested_fix: 'Condescending' here means humbly lowering oneself or showing condescension in the sense of compassionate humility (not 'obedient'). Render this nuance in Urdu (e.g., 'اخلاص کے ساتھ، عجز و انکساری کے ساتھ' or 'رحمدلی سے اپنے خدائی درجہ میں نازل ہو کر'). Keep meter/style sensitivity, but do not change theological meaning.
